resources.string: Allows TapPilot Agent to read on-screen UI elements, receive notification triggers, capture screen context for AI reasoning, and perform automated tap, scroll, and text-entry gestures on your behalf. A floating control pill with an instant Stop button remains visible during automation.
Native Kotlin Accessibility + Multi-Provider AI Agent
TapPilot uses Android AccessibilityService to read screen nodes, dispatch real tap gestures, and render a safe floating Stop overlay without extra display-over-apps permissions.
Runs continuously in background cycles, wakes immediately on new notifications, retains AI working memory, and blocks only payment/checkout actions.
Describe what the agent should do
e.g. Search Gillette Guard around 180tk, post in group, reply on Messenger
Enter a goal above and launch the agent. Every screen observation, notification trigger, AI decision, and tap coordinate will stream here.
Uses built-in Firebase AI Logic (gemini-3.8-flash) with App Check. No API key required.
Enter an API key above before launching with this provider.
Captures screen bitmap on Android 11+ alongside UI node tree for higher accuracy.
Allows posting, commenting, and messaging freely while pausing only for payments, checkout, or PIN/OTP.
Go to Home Screen on Launch
Automatically minimizes TapPilot so the agent starts directly from your launcher.
Prevents display sleep while TapPilot dashboard stays open for desk monitoring.
Keeps all-day AI screen & notification monitoring active with an instant Stop button.
